editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out your entire royal treasure was stolen right from under your nose. That is exactly what happens to King Caden, and he is not taking it lying down. You get to follow him as he rounds up a crew of knights to hunt down the thief. The heart of the story is Sir Daniel, a clumsy but determined knight who heads out on a wild journey with his donkey. It feels like a big, goofy road trip movie set in a fantasy world, filled with silly arguments and plenty of laughs. You will quickly find yourself rooting for the underdog and his four-legged friend.

What really works here is the chemistry between the characters and the fast pace that keeps you from getting bored. While some of the special effects look a bit simple, the comedy more than makes up for it. If you enjoy lighthearted adventures that do not take themselves too seriously, you will love this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a physical media fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this funny ride forever.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Sir Daniel and his donkey actually manage to outsmart the thief through a series of lucky accidents. After a big, messy fight involving all the knights, Daniel recovers the treasure and returns it to King Caden. The twist is that the donkey was the real hero the whole time, finding the secret hiding spot. Everything wraps up with a huge royal party where Daniel is honored as a true hero.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly fantasy comedies and animal sidekicks.
